column1: # Code groups with the contemporary glosses of the glossed original 438R/439R/439L/440L (letter and postscript
# to Gustav II Adolf, 20/30 Sept 1630; bare duplicate on 441-443) and of 444R (to L. Grubbe, 20/30 Sept 1630).
# Two transcription passes (second blind), arbitrated on the image. status: sure / probable (gloss partly legible or
# its share between adjacent groups uncertain) / doubtful / unresolved / conflict. Glosses kept in the form written.
